tasks.title: Essay: Priorities for a regional bus improvement plan
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been talking about how to improve bus services in your region. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important improvement to make to bus services in your region?

Notes

Write about:

1. frequency of buses
2. cost of tickets
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review: A bus improvement plan
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted

A regional bus improvement plan has been proposed for our area. Have you seen the plan or heard about it? Write a review of the plan for our magazine.

Explain what the plan aims to do, say whether you think it will be effective, and recommend one change you would make to improve it.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: How the bus plan affects young people
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a youth website.

Articles wanted

Bus plan: what does it mean for us?

Our region is planning to improve bus services. Write an article for our website explaining how the plan could affect young people in the area.

Describe one possible benefit and one possible drawback, and suggest what young people should do to make their voices heard.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Explaining your position on the bus plan
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Chris.

From: Chris
Subject: Bus plan in your area

Hi,
I heard that your region is planning to improve bus services. What do you think about the plan? Do you support it or not? Also, how will it affect your daily life? I'm curious about what changes you'd like to see.

Let me know!

Chris

Write your email.
